title: Calculate a CDS position's quote sensitivity
outcome: Calculate a CDS position's signed value change for a one-basis-point rise in the liquid tenor's market-standard quote by re-solving the flat hazard rate and revaluing the position for its own side.
misconceptions: A protection seller's value rises when the market quote rises.
The premium annuity can be held fixed while the quote moves, because only the protection leg depends on the hazard rate.
